## ADM Final Assignment

For visualising the testing results

Visualise data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

df1 <- read_csv("results_lowq_rand_basic.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    family = case_when(
      str_detect(algorithm, "^Online Threshold")   ~ "Online Threshold",
      str_detect(algorithm, "^Shrinking Threshold") ~ "Shrinking Threshold",
      TRUE ~ algorithm   # the two baselines keep their own name
    ),
    threshold = as.numeric(str_extract(algorithm, "[0-9.]+$"))
  )

baselines1 <- df1 %>% filter(is.na(threshold))
threshold_algos1 <- df1 %>% filter(!is.na(threshold))

```



```{r}

plot_metric_vs_threshold <- function(metric, loads_to_show = c(0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5)) {
  sub <- threshold_algos1 %>% filter(L %in% loads_to_show)
  base_sub <- baselines1 %>% filter(L %in% loads_to_show)
 
  ggplot(sub, aes(threshold, .data[[metric]], color = family)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_hline(data = base_sub, aes(yintercept = .data[[metric]], linetype = algorithm),
               color = "grey40") +
    facet_wrap(~ L, scales = "free_y", labeller = label_both) +
    labs(title = paste(metric, "vs. threshold, across load levels"),
         linetype = "Baseline", color = "Algorithm family") +
    theme_minimal()
}

plot_metric_vs_threshold("blocking_pairs")
ggsave("plot_A_blocking_vs_threshold.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)
 
plot_metric_vs_threshold("matched_rate")
ggsave("plot_A_matched_rate_vs_threshold.png", width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 150)

```


```{r}
ggplot(threshold_algos1, aes(blocking_pairs, matched_rate, color = family)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = interaction(family, L)), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(size = threshold), alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ L, labeller = label_both, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Efficiency frontier: matched rate vs. blocking pairs",
       subtitle = "each point = one threshold value, connected in increasing order") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("plot_B_tradeoff_frontier.png", width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 150)

```


```{r}
ggplot(threshold_algos1, aes(threshold, L, fill = blocking_pairs)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ family) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(title = "Blocking pairs across threshold and load (shared color scale)") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("plot_C_heatmap_shared_scale.png", width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

Check difference between n = 100 and n = 50

```{r}
target_L <- 1.5

threshold_algos1 %>%
  filter(near(L, target_L)) %>%       # near() avoids floating-point mismatches
  filter(blocking_pairs == min(blocking_pairs))
```
